extracted.name: Cranberry Hootycreeks
extracted.description: This festive cookie in a jar recipe layers flour, oats, sugar, dried cranberries, white chocolate chips, and pecans to make a great holiday gift.
instruction_lines: Layer ingredients in a 1-quart (1-liter) jar in the following order, pressing each layer down gently before adding the next: ⅝ cup all-purpose flour, rolled oats, ½ cup all-purpose flour, baking soda, salt, brown sugar, white sugar, dried cranberries, white chocolate chips, and chopped pecans. Seal jar tightly. Attach a card with the baking instructions below.
